name: Weblab PopUp Suite
author: weblabmd

sections.description:
Weblab PopUp Suite is a complete, free popup plugin for WordPress. Ideal for restaurants, online stores and any site that wants to promote products or collect email subscribers.

All features are free:

  • Multiple triggers: on load, scroll, exit-intent, click on element, manual
  • Advanced targeting: by device (desktop/mobile/tablet), user type, specific pages, membership level
  • Start/end scheduling for campaigns
  • Configurable frequency: once, always, or X times per Y days
  • Four content modes: site elements (any post type), image, email form, HTML/shortcode
  • Additional form mode: WPForms, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms
  • Countdown timer for urgency
  • A/B Testing with dedicated database tables
  • Multi-campaigns with priorities and snapshots
  • Email integrations: Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite, Webhook (Zapier/Make)
  • Advanced statistics: views, clicks, CTR, 7-day evolution, device breakdown, sources, top pages
  • CSV export for subscribers
  • Manual trigger via CSS class, HTML attribute, shortcode, or JS API
  • WooCommerce Advanced: sale prices, variations, stock status, add to cart button
  • WPML / Polylang translations
  • GDPR support: CookieYes, Complianz, Cookie Law Info
  • Cache bypass for WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, Varnish
  • Membership targeting: MemberPress, Paid Memberships Pro, RCP, WooCommerce Memberships

External services

This plugin can optionally connect to the following third-party services to add email subscribers to mailing lists. No data is sent to these services unless the site administrator explicitly configures the plugin with API credentials for a specific provider.

Mailchimp

Used to add subscribers collected via the popup to a Mailchimp audience.

Sent data: email address, optional first name.

When: only when a visitor submits the subscribe form AND the admin has configured the Mailchimp API key and List ID.

Service provided by Intuit Mailchimp.

  • Terms of Service: https://mailchimp.com/legal/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.intuit.com/privacy/statement/

Brevo (formerly Sendinblue)

Used to add subscribers to a Brevo contact list.

Sent data: email address, optional first name.

When: only when a visitor submits the subscribe form AND the admin has configured the Brevo API key and List ID.

Service provided by Sendinblue SAS.

  • Terms of Service: https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

MailerLite

Used to add subscribers to a MailerLite group.

Sent data: email address, optional name.

When: only when a visitor submits the subscribe form AND the admin has configured the MailerLite API key and Group ID.

Service provided by MailerLite Limited.

  • Terms of Service: https://www.mailerlite.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.mailerlite.com/legal/privacy-policy

Generic Webhook (Zapier, Make, n8n, custom)

Used to forward subscribers to a custom endpoint chosen by the site admin.

Sent data: email address, optional name, site URL, timestamp.

When: only when a visitor submits the subscribe form AND the admin has configured a webhook URL.

The webhook URL is fully controlled by the site administrator.

No third-party service is required; the admin chooses the destination.

GDPR consent

This plugin respects visitor consent for tracking. When a GDPR consent plugin is active (CookieYes, Complianz, or Cookie Law Info), statistics (view, click, close) and A/B testing are recorded only after the visitor gives consent. If no consent plugin is active, tracking is disabled by default. Administrators can toggle this in WebLab Popup -> General -> GDPR / Consent.

Developer hooks

WebLab PopUp Suite provides several filters for developers:

  • wlsp_popup_item_price – filter the price of each item
  • wlsp_popup_item_image – filter the image URL
  • wlsp_popup_item_link – filter the link URL
  • wlsp_popup_item_title – filter the item title
  • wlsp_popup_item_price_html – filter the full WooCommerce price HTML
  • wlsp_popup_currency – filter the currency code

Example:

add_filter( 'wlsp_popup_item_price', function( $price, $id, $post ) { return $price; }, 10, 3 );
sections.installation:
1. Upload the weblab-popup-suite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the popup from the ‘Weblab PopUp’ menu in the admin panel.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes, 100%. All features are active without any license or key.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. When the “WooCommerce Advanced” option is enabled, the popup shows sale prices, variations, stock status and an “Add to cart” button.

Can I collect emails?

Yes. You can integrate with Mailchimp, Brevo, MailerLite, or a generic webhook. All emails are also saved locally as a backup.

Can I test different variants?

Yes. The A/B Testing module allows you to create tests with multiple variants and see which one converts better.

Can I trigger the popup manually?

Yes. Use the CSS class wlsp-open-popup, the HTML attribute data-wlsp-open-popup, the shortcode [wlsp_popup_trigger], or the JavaScript API window.wlspOpenPopup().

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. The plugin sends no-cache headers for its tracking endpoints, keeping statistics accurate with WP Rocket, LiteSpeed, Varnish, or Cloudflare.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. When “Respect consent” is enabled, the plugin waits for consent from CookieYes, Complianz, or Cookie Law Info before tracking visitors.
sections.changelog:
4.0.3

  • Fixed fatal error in the admin class (missing get_content_data method introduced during the previous cleanup)
  • Removed remaining Custom CSS references from readme

4.0.2

  • Removed Custom CSS from readme (feature was intentionally removed in 4.0.1)
  • Fixed line endings in admin view files

4.0.1

  • Removed arbitrary Custom CSS feature per WordPress.org guidelines
  • Renamed meliPopupSettings to weblabPopupSettings
  • Moved inline scripts to enqueued JS files
  • Removed .po/.mo translation files (handled by translate.wordpress.org)
  • Removed load_plugin_textdomain() call (not needed on WordPress.org since 4.6)
  • Fixed double <?php opening tag in main plugin file
  • Removed 404 Donate link
  • Added External Services documentation
  • Added GDPR consent section
  • Enabled GDPR consent as default for tracking

4.0.0

  • Unified 100% free version
  • Removed licensing system
  • All Pro features are now free
  • Code cleaned for WordPress.org compliance
  • Added WooCommerce Advanced integration
  • Added form integrations (WPForms, CF7, Gravity Forms)
  • Added manual trigger (CSS/JS/shortcode)
  • Added WPML/Polylang translations
  • Added GDPR support
  • Added cache bypass
  • Added membership targeting
